name: FitsRanks.sum_diagramWeight_eq_boxes
summary: Exchange the order of summation and count, for each height h', the indices i below it.

steps.claim: Expand the diagram weights as double sums Σ_τ Σ_{i<|n|} Σ_{i<h'<|n'|} κ_τ(h') and exchange the sums over i and h' (sum_comm'): the claim becomes, for each τ and h' < |n'|, #{i < |n| : i < h'}·κ_τ(h') = h'·κ_τ(h').
For h' ≤ |n| the count #{i < h'} is h' (Fin.card_filter_val_lt); for |n| < h' < |n'| the factor κ_τ(h') vanishes by FitsRanks (h); the remaining arithmetic is checked by grind.
